summary: Aroostook County, ME: a Maine Forest Service fire tower at the Mouth of the Oxbow Road appears on a 1945 panoramic map; listed as gone; site today not described.

facts.status_note: Listed as Tower Gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source gives a removal date

notes_for_editor: Three sources only. The 1959 'auxiliary lookout' line on the Forest Lookouts page belongs to the Otter Lake Mountain entry above Oxbow, not to Oxbow; Oxbow's own entry there reads only 'Auxiliary Lookout', with no dates. No build, staffing, removal or site-condition source was found. The Oak Hill tower, about five miles south and standing, is a different site and is not used. Photo candidate: the 1945 map (Maine State Archives item 47); no image URL was captured, so no photos entry.
